repair.cwd_restored: Restored the project path on {count} agent events.
repair.durations_capped: Capped {count} agent event durations left unbounded.
repair.phantoms_removed: Removed {count} agent events with no matching start.

export.help: Print finished hours per local day, per project, client and category. Reads the store only.
export.since: First day to export, as YYYY-MM-DD.
export.until: Last day to export, as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.
export.json: Print the schema 1 JSON. This is the default.
export.csv: Print hours per day and client, rounded to 15 minutes.

tester.help: Show what each category and client rule matched over recent days, in hours.
tester.days: How many days back to read, today included.
tester.empty: No activity in the last {days} days. Start the daemon to begin tracking.

importer.help: Bring history from another tracker into hyndsyght.

aw.help: Import window and away history from ActivityWatch. It stops where hyndsyght's own recording begins, and running it again replaces what it imported before.
aw.url: Address of a running ActivityWatch server.
aw.file: Read an ActivityWatch export (the JSON from /api/0/export) instead of a running server.
aw.host: Only import buckets from this computer name. Repeat it for more than one.
aw.dry_run: Show what would be imported without writing anything.
aw.cutoff: Stopped at {time}, where hyndsyght's own recording begins, so no minute is counted twice.
aw.dry_run_done: Dry run: {rows} rows would be imported. Nothing was written.
aw.none: No ActivityWatch window or away buckets found.
aw.unreachable: Can't reach ActivityWatch at {url}. Start it, or pass --file with an export.
